page.overview:
What is Flareon?

Flareon is a quadrupedal, mammalian, felid Pokémon with some slight lagomorph traits. It has vivid flame-colored red-orange fur covering most of its body. A bushy yellow mane encircles its neck. Similar in appearance to its collar, it has a large, puffy, yellow flame-shaped tail, as well as a tuft of yellow fur atop its head, which is also flame-like in shape. This Pokémon is stocky in physical build, with a round head and short cat-like muzzle. It has wide, black almond-shaped eyes, and a small black triangular nose. Its ears are long and rabbit-like, with flare-shaped tips. It has large, bulky paws with no visible claws. Flareon's body (even when not including the particularly fluffy yellow fur) is generally bulkier than most of the Eeveelutions. Compared to its counterparts, it resembles its pre-evolution, Eevee, the most. Flareon is the result of Eevee absorbing a Fire Stone.

When Shiny, Flareon's red-orange fur is a lighter, yellow-gold shade of color.

Flareon is generally a shy Pokémon, as seen in the anime series, specifically Eevee and Friends. It is very emotionally sensible and when it is nervous, it releases large amounts of heat through its fur. Flareon can also be shy when meeting new Trainers. However, like most other Eeveelutions, it has a warm-hearted personality. Usually, Flareon doesn't like being the center of attention.

Flareon is also an altruistic and loyal Pokémon, as it would give its life just for its Trainer, similar to Espeon and Leafeon. Although Flareon has a warm-hearted and submissive personality, if it gets angry, it tends to be hot-headed and explosive.
